subject: nineTailedKitsune
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: nine-tailed kitsune fox with spirit flames.
Style: high-fantasy anime.
reasoning:
Looking at the renders, I'm noticing the fox's body proportions seem off—too thin and long with spindly legs, and the head looks small and hound-like compared to the massive tail fans. I'm considering enlarging the head to balance things out, and now turning my attention to the flame effects.

The flame shapes resemble fish or tulips rather than flames, which isn't ideal but passable; more problematic is a cyan flame sitting at the chest that blocks the face in front view, so I should filter out ring flames positioned near the fox's centerline. I'm also rethinking the torii's kasagi beam, which currently reads as a flat black slab—I want to lighten it to something like a dark indigo-purple instead. Lastly I'm noticing messy grey shard-like artifacts on the tail tufts that look unintentional and need cleaning up.

Widening ears a bit more too. Chest ruff, dais, rune glow, grass and embers all look fine as is, though the legs seem a little oddly bent in the side view — I'll leave that alone for now. The flame shapes bother me though, since the forked tips read as fish tails rather than fire; I want to reshape them into teardrop forms with curling points instead.

I should also check which flames end up positioned in front of the fox's body and adjust their angular placement so none overlap the chest area, shifting the angle range to avoid the front-facing zone around -35°.

Adjusting eye size slightly larger, tweaking ring flame phi, fixing BLACKW color, and changing tail card proportions with a steeper lean for a sharper tuft shape. I'm also widening the ear outline and inner ear shape to give them a broader, more pointed silhouette.
